verdict.rationale: Unit is a financial infrastructure platform, so data portability is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack contains no documented bulk export, open-format export, or offboarding capability. The general statement that the Dashboard and APIs give teams access to their data is adjacent at most and is not an export-and-leave feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
